papers.title: Finding the perfect promoter for Cas9 in homing gene drives using single cell transcriptome data
papers.abstract: CRISPR homing gene drives can help control disease vectors but require precise Cas9 expression. Here, the drive performance of 35 Cas9 constructs with different promoters in Drosophila were compared to single cell RNA expression patterns of promoter-associated genes.
papers.titleZh: 利用單細胞轉錄組資料找出Cas9同源基因驅動的最佳啟動子
papers.summaryZh: CRISPR 同源基因驅動有望調控病媒昆蟲，但其效能高度依賴 Cas9 的精準表達。本研究在果蠅中測試了 35 種不同啟動子驅動的 Cas9 建構，並將其表現與單細胞轉錄組中各啟動子相關基因的表達模式比對，揭示了驅動效能與基因表達強度的關聯。這些結果提供了系統性篩選啟動子的方法，為設計更高效、可控的基因驅動系統提供了重要參考。

papers.title: Scalable high resolution ancestry deconvolution for genomic data
papers.abstract: The authors present Gnomix, a local ancestry framework that delivers leading accuracy across diverse admixed datasets on both whole-genome and array data with high efficiency, together with Gnofix, its fast phasing-error correction counterpart.
papers.titleZh: 可擴展的高解析度基因組祖先來源分析框架
papers.summaryZh: 本研究推出 Gnomix 系統，這是一套能在大規模混合族群基因組資料中精確識別祖先來源區塊的本地祖先推斷框架。Gnomix 在全基因組和晶片資料上均展現領先的準確率，同時具備高效運算能力，可處理大規模族群資料。搭配 Gnofix 快速修正定相錯誤的輔助工具，進一步提升分析結果的可靠性。此技術對於理解人類遷徙歷史、解析複雜疾病遺傳機制，以及推動精準醫學發展具有重要價值。

papers.title: DICER1-related tumour predisposition mutations increase 3p-miRNA function and HERVH activity
papers.abstract: DICER1 is often mutated in cancer, including in DICER1-related tumour predisposition. Here, the authors show that cancer-associated DICER1 mutations shift microRNA processing and reactivate HERVH endogenous retroviruses.
papers.titleZh: DICER1相關腫瘤易感突變增加3p-miRNA功能與HERVH活性
papers.summaryZh: DICER1突變常見於多種癌症中，包括DICER1相關腫瘤易感症候群。本研究發現，癌症相關的DICER1突變會改變微小RNA的加工處理過程，並重新活化HERVH內源性逆轉錄病毒。這項發現闡明了DICER1突變致癌的新機制，可能為DICER1相關癌症的診斷和治療提供新的標的。

papers.title: Neural dynamics for working memory and evidence integration during olfactory navigation in Drosophila
papers.abstract: The authors describe a population of neurons in the navigation center of Drosophila that exhibits a persistent goal signal during olfactory navigation.
papers.titleZh: 果蠅嗅覺導航的神經動態：工作記憶與證據整合
papers.summaryZh: 本研究描述了果蠅導航中樞中一群神經元，這些神經元在嗅覺導航過程中展現出持續性的目標訊號。研究結果揭示了工作記憶與證據整合的神經機制，為理解動物如何利用嗅覺資訊進行導航提供了重要見解。這項發現有助於我們進一步了解大腦如何維持和運用目標導向的記憶來指導行為決策。

paper.title: Scaling and Population Loss in Mexican Urban Centres
paper.abstract: We analysed urban growth dynamics in 69 Mexican metropolitan areas from 1990 to 2020 using radial scaling analysis. In 30 years, the urban population shifted outwards, with all central zones losing 2.5 million people, absorbed by the peripheries.

paper.title: Electrically driven inverse metamagnetic transition in Sm1-xSrxMnO₃
paper.abstract: Correlated oxides are known to exhibit metamagnetic switching from a non-ferromagnetic to ferromagnetic phase. Here, the authors demonstrate an electrically driven inverse-metamagnetic transition from a ferromagnetic state to an antiferromagnetic-like phase in an epitaxial Sm1-xSrxMnO3 thin film.

paper.title: Retarding moisture-induced chemical degradation of Yttrium Tellurides by tailoring grain boundary chemistry
paper.abstract: Y2Te3 thermoelectrics degrade in moist air as water molecules enter along grain boundaries. The authors show that 1 at.% Bi segregates to these boundaries, suppressing moisture ingress and preventing chemical degradation while preserving performance.
